panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Firing in Alertmanager, excluding the Watchdog heartbeat.

panels.title: Mains
panels.description: ups.status OL flag from the UPS on pve-1.

panels.title: Internet
panels.description: TCP connect to 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8. Offline only when both fail.

panels.title: VPS
panels.description: inside.merox.dev — the off-site backup target.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Proxmox hosts answering. Each carries one control plane.

panels.title: K8s nodes
panels.description: Ready nodes. Two is still a quorum; one is not.

panels.title: NAS
panels.description: The Synology's SMB port. The one live store: media, Drive, Photos, every backup's landing.

panels.title: Stuck pods
panels.description: Pending, Failed or Unknown.

panels.title: Last 24 h
panels.description: Share of minutes the cluster reached 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8. Down covers power, hosts, Kubernetes and the WAN alike; minutes with no data count as down.

panels.title: Last 7 days
panels.description: Share of minutes the cluster reached 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8. Down covers power, hosts, Kubernetes and the WAN alike; minutes with no data count as down.

panels.title: Last 30 days
panels.description: Share of minutes the cluster reached 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8. Down covers power, hosts, Kubernetes and the WAN alike; minutes with no data count as down.

panels.title: Online
panels.description: Over the dashboard's time range. Red is an outage — or no data, which is treated the same.

panels.title: Local backup
panels.description: Oldest last-backup among the Longhorn volumes that are backed up — to Garage on pve-3 (data on the NAS), nightly at 23:50. Per-volume detail is in the Longhorn dashboard.

panels.title: Backup jobs
panels.description: Checks that healthchecks.io currently has down — the vault's daily run (pull, snapshots, restic to Oracle), the VPS backup, Oracle's retention, the drills. healthchecks.io pages on Telegram; this tile is the glance.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Until the soonest certificate expires. Let's Encrypt shortlived: ~6.7 days, renewed at ~2.2 days left, so anything above 2 days is normal.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Used by every container, against what the three nodes can allocate.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of every container, against allocatable memory. Working set is what the OOM killer counts.

panels.title: Apps
panels.description: Ready against desired replicas for every app in the default namespace. `platform` is everything else — Flux, Cilium, Longhorn, cert-manager, observability, their DaemonSets included — Up only while none of it is short.

targets.expr: ((count((kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace!="default"} / (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace!="default"} > 0)) < 1) or vector(0)) + (count((kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace!="default"} / (kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace!="default"} > 0)) < 1) or vector(0)) + (count((kube_daemonset_status_number_ready{namespace!="default"} / (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{namespace!="default"} > 0)) < 1) or vector(0))) == bool 0

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Last Ookla speedtest. Runs every 4 h — each run moves ~1.8 GB.

panels.title: Upload
panels.description: Last Ookla speedtest. Runs every 4 h — each run moves ~1.8 GB.

panels.title: Round trip
panels.description: TCP handshake to the nearer of 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8, measured constantly.

panels.title: Throughput history
panels.description: One point per test, every 4 h, so the line steps rather than curves.

panels.title: Round trip history
panels.description: Gaps are outages: a failed probe has no round trip to plot.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Hottest hwmon sensor per host — CPU cores and NVMe.

panels.title: Storage fill
panels.description: Every Proxmox storage on every host. PveStorageNearFull fires at 80 %, Critical at 90 %.

panels.title: SSD wear
panels.description: Rated endurance used. pve-1's nvme1n1 is the QLC drive that took 3.5x write amplification under a ZFS zvol until 2026-09-07 — the one to watch. The vault's disks report through TrueNAS, not here.

panels.title: Runtime left
panels.description: NUT shuts every host down at 300 s (battery.runtime.low).

panels.title: Estate draw
panels.description: Everything behind the UPS: the three hosts, the NAS and the network. Derived: it reports load only as a percentage of 390 W. The vault is not on the UPS.

panels.title: Draw history
panels.description: Everything behind the UPS.

panels.title: Runtime history
panels.description: Estimated on mains. Drifting down over months is how the battery announces its age.
